parsed.post: New personal best: 1.0324! The reduction in learning rate seems to have helped stability and convergence. I'm now going to experiment with reducing the batch size to 262144 to see if more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget can push this further, while keeping the improved LR.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate further to 0.03 and halving batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
